# harness_platform_connector_anthropic_model (Data Source)

Datasource for looking up an Anthropic Model connector.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "harness_platform_connector_anthropic_model" "example" {
  identifier = "identifier"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identifier` (String) Unique identifier of the resource.

### Optional

- `name` (String) Name of the resource.
- `org_id` (String) Unique identifier of the organization.
- `project_id` (String) Unique identifier of the project.

### Read-Only

- `auth` (List of Object) The authentication configuration for the Anthropic connector. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--auth))
- `delegate_selectors` (Set of String) Tags to filter delegates for connection.
- `description` (String) Description of the resource.
- `execute_on_delegate` (Boolean) Execute on delegate or not.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ignore_test_connection` (Boolean) Ignore test connection when creating or updating the connector.
- `model` (String) The Anthropic model to use.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags to associate with the resource.
- `url` (String) URL of the Anthropic API endpoint.
